name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – After § 1 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: 1d. Calls for the EU to urgently launch an ambitious diplomatic initiative to secure an immediate ceasefire and put an end to the war in Ukraine and the suffering of the Ukrainian people; calls for increased efforts to finally initiate a peace negotiation process that includes all parties;
